description: Eval scenarios for gsd-tester — test generation specialist agent. All graders are code-based in v3.0.

scenarios.input_description: Given a coverage-guided test task, verify the agent file contains the CoverUp pattern for iterative coverage improvement.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation describes the CoverUp pattern for iteratively improving coverage up to a target threshold.

scenarios.input_description: Given an E2E test task, verify the agent file contains the Playwright Page Object Model (POM) rule.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation specifies that Playwright E2E tests must use the Page Object Model pattern with POM classes in tests/pages/.

scenarios.input_description: Given a property-based test task, verify the agent file contains the fast-check library reference for property testing.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation references fast-check as the property testing library and specifies usage with fc.assert().

scenarios.input_description: Given a test quality review, verify the agent file contains the boundary rule delegating quality evaluation to gsd-qa.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation explicitly states that test quality, mutation scores, and pyramid ratios are gsd-qa's responsibility — not the tester's.

grading_criteria.pattern_to_grep: gsd-qa evaluates the tests you generate

scenarios.input_description: Given max iterations for the CoverUp loop, verify the agent file contains the 5-iteration limit rule.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation specifies that the CoverUp loop stops at 5 iterations even if the 80% coverage target is not reached.
